title: Ivo and the Garden
premise: When the border wards collapse and the stars go dark, charm-seller Xanthe Blackwood discovers their guild's founding secret: the wards were powered by a soul the guild sold to the court beneath the mountain seven years ago — the soul of Ivo, the child they raised as their own apprentice. Guided by a fading dragon named Emberfall, whose fire is the last light in a starless sky, Xanthe descends into the mountain court to steal Ivo's soul back. They succeed only by offering their own memories of Ivo as payment, and the book ends with Xanthe returning to a city that remembers magic but no longer remembers them, while Ivo, restored and grieving, relights the first star.
about_author: Theo Oyelaran is a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing oral histories of displaced communities before turning to fiction. He writes fantasy about what people trade away to survive, and lives between Lagos and Lisbon.

chapters.title: Charms for a City That Forbids Them
chapters.summary: Xanthe Blackwood sells a luck-knot to a dockworker, hiding their guild's last magic behind mundane trinkets. POV: Xanthe. The beat is weary tenderness — survival as habit, love disguised as commerce.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Every star vanishes at once; the border wards shatter like glass. Xanthe feels the guild's protective sigils die on their skin. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into recognition — this was not an accident but a debt called due.

chapters.title: What the Guild Ledger Would Not Say
chapters.summary: In the ruined guildhall, Xanthe finds the ledger's final page: a contract selling 'one soul, freely given' to the court beneath the mountain, dated seven years ago. POV: Xanthe. Beat: horror as they realize the date matches the night Ivo disappeared.

chapters.title: Emberfall Descends
chapters.summary: A dying dragon lands in the guild courtyard, her scales dimming. She reveals she carried the soul-payment herself and has come to guide whoever dares retrieve it. POV: Emberfall. Beat: reluctant alliance between two creatures running out of time.

chapters.title: Seven Years of Small Kindnesses
chapters.summary: Flashback chapter: Xanthe teaching young Ivo to knot charms, sharing stolen plums, promising nothing bad would happen while the guild stood. POV: Xanthe. Beat: warm memory made unbearable by what the reader now knows.

chapters.title: The Road Under the World
chapters.summary: Xanthe and Emberfall enter the sunken road beneath the city, where outlawed magic pools like water. Emberfall warns that the court trades in memory as currency. POV: alternating. Beat: commitment — there is no road back that doesn't pass through the mountain.

chapters.title: The Tollgate of Names
chapters.summary: A gatekeeper demands a name as toll; travelers who pay forget themselves. Xanthe pays with a false name and barely keeps their own. POV: Xanthe. Beat: first taste of the price the court exacts, foreshadowing the ending.

chapters.title: The Court Beneath the Mountain
chapters.summary: They arrive at a cathedral cavern lit by bottled souls, presided over by the Magistrate of Debts. Ivo's soul is displayed as the court's prize acquisition. POV: Xanthe. Beat: awe curdling into fury at seeing a child reduced to collateral.

chapters.title: Terms of Trade
chapters.summary: The Magistrate explains the original bargain: the guild bought seven years of ward-protection with Ivo's soul, signed by the guildmaster — Xanthe's mentor. POV: Xanthe. Beat: betrayal; the people who raised Xanthe sold the child they both loved.

chapters.title: The Guildmaster's Confession
chapters.summary: Dying guildmaster Merrin arrives, having followed them down, and admits she signed the contract when the city outlawed magic and the guild faced extinction. POV: Merrin. Beat: guilt without excuse; she chose the many over the one and cannot forgive herself.

chapters.title: Ivo, As He Is Now
chapters.summary: Xanthe reaches Ivo's bottled soul and finds it aware, dreaming, reaching toward them through the glass. POV: Ivo (dream-logic). Beat: heartbreak — he remembers everything, including being given away.

chapters.title: First Attempt: Theft
chapters.summary: Xanthe tries to steal the bottle outright and triggers the court's defenses; Emberfall burns a path out but is gravely wounded, her fire nearly guttering. POV: Xanthe. Beat: failure and cost — force will not work here.

chapters.title: The Currency of Memory
chapters.summary: Recovering in a smuggler's alcove, Xanthe learns the court accepts equivalent payment: a soul can be ransomed with memories of equal weight. POV: Emberfall. Beat: dawning sacrifice — Xanthe's memories of Ivo are the richest currency in the room.

chapters.title: Merrin's Last Payment
chapters.summary: Guildmaster Merrin offers her own memories of the guild's founding to lower the price, dissolving into namelessness as she pays. POV: Merrin. Beat: partial redemption — she gives everything except the years she stole from Ivo.

chapters.title: Negotiation with the Magistrate
chapters.summary: Xanthe bargains formally: their memories of Ivo against his soul. The Magistrate, intrigued by love offered freely, sets a cruel condition — Xanthe must surrender the memories willingly and remember giving them. POV: Xanthe. Beat: terror and resolve entwined.

chapters.title: The Weighing
chapters.summary: The court weighs Xanthe's memories against Ivo's soul and finds them sufficient — barely. Emberfall adds her final flame to tip the scale. POV: Emberfall. Beat: climax begins; everything precious placed on the scale at once.

chapters.title: What Xanthe Gave
chapters.summary: The extraction: Xanthe watches their seven years with Ivo leave them, feeling the love remain as shapeless warmth with no story attached. POV: Xanthe. Beat: devastating transcendence — paying the ultimate price and staying conscious for it.

chapters.title: Ivo Wakes
chapters.summary: Ivo returns to flesh in the collapsing court, holding a stranger (Xanthe) who weeps without knowing why. POV: Ivo. Beat: reunion inverted — saved by someone he no longer exists in.

chapters.title: Escape by Dragon-Light
chapters.summary: Emberfall, nearly extinguished, carries them up the sunken road as the court pursues its escaped asset. Her last fire seals the mountain behind them. POV: alternating. Beat: desperate flight, sacrifice completing itself.

chapters.title: The First Star
chapters.summary: Above ground, Ivo uses his returned soul-fire to kindle the first new star; the wards reknit around the city. Emberfall dies as dawn breaks, content. POV: Ivo. Beat: grief and triumph in one breath — the world saved, the savior unremembered.

chapters.title: A Stranger at the Door
chapters.summary: Ivo finds Xanthe back at the charm-stall, polite and empty-handed of him. He begins telling Xanthe their own stories, one each day. POV: Ivo. Beat: tender ache — love rebuilt from testimony rather than memory.

chapters.title: The Garden
chapters.summary: One year later, Ivo plants a garden on the old guild grounds and names each row for a memory he returned in story-form; Xanthe, slowly, begins to feel the warmth attach to something again. POV: alternating. Beat: resolution — inheritance reversed, memory regrown, survival finally worth its price.
